# Make Demo Datasets

```{r}
genodf <- read.csv("Genotype_Files/proportion_imputed_geno.csv")

genodf <- genodf[2:1740,2:1740]

write.csv(genodf,"Demo_Data/Genotype/Chris_Geno.csv")

weather <- read.csv("Weather_Data/4GS_Binned_Weather_Data_Mean.csv")

weather <- weather[6:14,]

write.csv(weather,"Demo_Data/Environment/Chris_locs.csv")

```


# Demo Function

```{r}
library(xgboost)
library(dplyr)

predict_xgb_model <- function(
    traitlist,
    genotype_path,
    environment_path,
    model_name,
    genotype_id_col = "LINE_UNIQUE_ID",
    environment_id_col = "LOC_YEAR",
    output_path = "Demo_Data/Predictions"
) {
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Load model
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  full_results <- NULL
  
  for(t in 1:length(traitlist)){
    
    trait = traitlist[t]
    
  model_path <- file.path(
    "Demo_Data/Models",
    trait,
    paste0(model_name, ".json")
  )
  
  if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
    stop("Model file not found: ", model_path)
  }
  
  model <- xgb.load(model_path)
  
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Load genotype and environmental data
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  
  genotype <- read.csv(genotype_path)
  environment <- read.csv(environment_path)
  
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Save identifiers
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  
  genotype_ids <- genotype[[genotype_id_col]]
  environment_ids <- environment[[environment_id_col]]
  
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Remove identifier columns
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  
  genotype_x <- genotype |>
    select(-c(all_of(genotype_id_col),"X"))
  
  environment_x <- environment |>
    select(last_col(offset = 23):last_col())
  
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Create prediction combinations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  
  # Every genotype × environment combination
  prediction_df <- expand.grid(
    genotype_id = genotype_ids,
    environment_id = environment_ids,
    KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Create feature matrix
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  
  # Repeat genotype data for every environment
  genotype_rep <- genotype_x[
    match(prediction_df$genotype_id, genotype_ids),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Repeat environmental data for every genotype
  environment_rep <- environment_x[
    match(prediction_df$environment_id, environment_ids),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  rownames(genotype_rep) <- NULL
  rownames(environment_rep) <- NULL
  
  prediction_matrix <- cbind(
    genotype_rep,
    environment_rep
  )
  
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Make predictions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  
  predictions <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = as.matrix(prediction_matrix)
  )
  
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. Combine results
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  
  results <- prediction_df |>
    mutate(
      Trait = trait,
      Prediction = predictions
    )
  
  
  full_results <- rbind(full_results,results)
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 9. Optionally save predictions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (!is.null(output_path)) {
    write.csv(
      results,
      paste0(output_path,"/",trait,"_",model_name,".csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  }
  
  return(results)

}

```


```{r}
YLD_predictions <- predict_xgb_model(
    traitlist = c("YLD_BE","PHT","TWT"),
    genotype_path = "Demo_Data/Genotype/Chris_geno.csv",
    environment_path = "Demo_Data/Environment/Chris_locs.csv",
    model_name = "XGB_2007"
)

```
